capture: portrait phone photo of the PM5 monitor, straight on, LCD fills about two thirds of the width, window light behind
notes: Single 500m piece with 100m splits. The time column holds per-split times and the meter column is cumulative, so laps are 100m each. Split times are printed without a leading minute (:16.8). The /500m column on split rows is the pace of that split alone (e.g. 17.1s x 5 = 1:25.5). No heart rate column values. Screen is the View Detail page with the summary row highlighted. The monitor model label is cut off at the right edge (PM5).
